messages:
Maya Chen: FYI I'm refreshing the StarterFlow quickstart — goal: replace old fetch-based snippets, make auth and deploy instructions consistent across Node/Python and container examples. Filing a PR in a few minutes.
Samir Patel: SG. Can you call out the env var name change? a bunch of examples still use REDWOOD_KEY instead of REDWOOD_API_KEY.
Maya Chen: Yup, plan to normalize to REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere. Also adding a short troubleshoot section for the common 401 during local docker runs.
Evelyn Torres: PR link when ready? I can run through the Node snippets and test the deploy steps.
Maya Chen: PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/613> — draft for now. Main changes: auth var rename, Node and Python snippets for hello-starterflow, add Dockerfile + `docker run` auth instructions, and a quick note about dataset-free evals.
Raul Gomez: Quick note — the container example needs a healthcheck and a minimal procfile note for Heroku-like deploys. Also suggest adding the `--net=host` caveat for Linux devs.
Maya Chen: Good call. Adding a one-liner healthcheck and a sample `CMD` in Dockerfile.
Luca (devex): Can we also add an SDK v2 snippet that shows streaming response usage? A couple of customers asked for streaming in quickstart.
Maya Chen: Will include a tiny Node streaming example and a Python generator example. Draft snippet:

```js
// Node streaming example (pseudo)
const resp = await client.chat.stream({model: 'redwood-compact', messages: [{role:'user', content:'Hello'}]});
for await (const chunk of resp) { process.stdout.write(chunk.delta); }
```

and Python:

```py
# Python streaming generator
for chunk in client.chat.stream(model='redwood-compact', messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}]):
    print(chunk.delta, end='')
```

Samir Patel: Nice. I noticed an auth footnote in the old doc about scope that isn't true for the hosted API — remove it.
Maya Chen: Removing. Also fixing a broken internal link to /api/usage which previously 404'd. Updated to /api/usage/overview.
DocsBot: Automated check: markdown link check failed in docs/quickstart/starterflow.md: line 72 -> /api/usage (404). Suggest edit committed.
Maya Chen: Thanks DocsBot — I pushed a fix in the branch.
Evelyn Torres: I'll test the docker flow: build -> run with env var -> curl health endpoint. If I hit any 401 I’ll paste logs here.
Raul Gomez: For the deploy section, add a short blurb on Dedicated fallback behavior: when model is not available in region it automatically routes to nearest compatible variant — important to set user expectations.
Maya Chen: Adding that note and linking to runtime routing page.
Luca (devex): One tiny nit — the code block for curl currently shows the old header `X-API-KEY`. Update to `Authorization: Bearer <token>` everywhere.
Maya Chen: Done.
Evelyn Torres: Ran through the Node and Docker steps locally, all green. Found one small token parsing bug in the example snippet (extra backtick). PR updated.
Samir Patel: Reviewed the Node snippets and the streaming example — LGTM. Two suggestions: reduce code lines to fit the quickstart (keep it under 12 lines) and add a one-sentence explanation of streaming vs non-streaming.
Maya Chen: Trimmed the examples, added one-sentence comparison. Marked PR ready for review.
DocsBot: CI: md-lint OK; link-check OK; code-sample tests passed.
Maya Chen: @Samir @Evelyn @Luca thanks — once merged I'll trigger the docs site deploy. Plan to announce the quickstart refresh in #all-hands tomorrow. :tada:
Evelyn Torres: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with a small testcase that exercises the auth rotation flow.
Raul Gomez: :rocket: Good job — this will make onboarding smoother.
Maya Chen: Merging in ~10m unless any objections.
